project_type: Python Streamlit app (LinkedIn content optimization SaaS)
build_system: pip with requirements.txt; no Makefile or Dockerfile
test_framework: pytest with tests/conftest.py providing fake Streamlit session state and sys.path setup
build_command: export PYENV_VERSION=3.11.15 && python -c 'import post_generator; import post_optimizer; import repurposing_engine; import engagement_toolkit; import content_ideas; import engagement_intelligence; import app'
verification_instructions: 1. Run pytest to confirm all tests pass. 2. Verify imports of all modified modules succeed without errors.
environment_constraints: pyenv required (PYENV_VERSION=3.11.15). No Docker. No Streamlit runtime in test (faked via conftest.py).
contribution_requirements: All tests must pass. Voice system in core/voice.py is the single source of truth for all prompts.
key_patterns: Each module has a build_*_prompt() function that composes from core/voice.py constants (HUMAN_VOICE_PRIMER, SHORT_PRIMER, BANNED, HUMAN_SIGNATURES, STRUCTURE_RULES). Post Generator uses few-shot examples from core/examples.py via get_examples(). The validator (core/validator.py) scores posts/hooks/comments. Pipeline buttons use st.session_state keys + st.rerun() for navigation.
directory_structure: Root: app.py (main Streamlit app with Hook Analyzer + Carousel Planner inline), module files (post_generator.py, post_optimizer.py, etc.), core/ (voice.py, examples.py, validator.py, ai.py, etc.), tests/ (pytest tests)
